例句

  1. Quite a few elderly women look down on their husbands, who cannot do anything by themselves and ask too much of them.
    有不少老太太看不起自己的丈夫，因為他們自己什麼事都不會做，又對她們要求太多。
  2. Quite a few students walk to school.
    相當多學生走路上學。
  3. There are quite a few good restaurants near here.
    這附近有相當多好餐廳。
  4. Quite a few people came to the school festival.
    相當多人來參加校慶。
  5. I made quite a few mistakes on the test.
    我考試犯了相當多錯。
  6. Few people know this small town.
    很少人知道這個小鎮。
  7. There were few cars on the road at midnight.
    半夜路上車子很少。
  8. Ken has a few comic books in his bag.
    Ken 的包包裡有幾本漫畫。
  9. Quite a few people were waiting at the bus stop.
    公車站有相當多人在等。
  10. My aunt, who is a nurse, works at night.
    我阿姨是護理師，她晚上工作。
  11. Can you finish the work by yourself?
    你可以自己完成這份工作嗎？
  12. I spoke to Mr. Lin, who teaches math at my school.
    我跟林老師說了話，他在我們學校教數學。
  13. Quite a few students in my class wear glasses.
    我們班相當多學生戴眼鏡。
  14. My little brother tied his shoes by himself for the first time.
    我弟弟第一次自己綁鞋帶。
  15. I called my aunt, who lives in Osaka.
    我打電話給我阿姨，她住在大阪。
  16. Our teacher, who is from Canada, speaks French.
    我們老師是加拿大人，他會說法文。
  17. I met Mr. Sato, who used to teach my father.
    我見到了佐藤先生，他以前教過我爸爸。
  18. My grandmother, who is eighty, still rides her bike every day.
    我奶奶八十歲了，還是每天騎腳踏車。
  19. I asked Tom, who knows a lot about computers.
    我問了 Tom，他很懂電腦。
  20. We thanked the bus driver, who helped us find our hotel.
    我們謝謝公車司機，他幫我們找到了飯店。
  21. My little sister can dress by herself.
    我妹妹可以自己穿衣服。
  22. I made this cake by myself.
    這個蛋糕是我自己做的。
  23. Did you do your homework by yourself?
    你的功課是你自己寫的嗎？
  24. The old man lives by himself.
    那位老先生一個人住。
  25. The children cleaned the classroom by themselves.
    孩子們自己打掃了教室。
  26. We planned the whole trip by ourselves.
    我們自己規劃了整趟旅行。
  27. Quite a few husbands in Japan can't cook by themselves.
    在日本，相當多丈夫自己不會做飯。
  28. My uncle, who can't cook by himself, buys his dinner at a convenience store every day.
    我叔叔自己不會做飯，他每天都在便利商店買晚餐。
  29. Quite a few tourists don't know about this beach.
    相當多遊客不知道這片海灘。
  30. I want to visit my grandparents, who live alone in the country.
    我想去看我的爺爺奶奶，他們自己住在鄉下。
  31. I'll be back in a few minutes.
    我過幾分鐘就回來。
  32. Don't look down on people who have less money than you.
    不要看不起錢比你少的人。
  33. He looks down on anyone who can't speak English.
    他看不起任何不會說英文的人。
  34. I have always looked up to my older brother.
    我一直很尊敬我哥哥。
  35. I can't put up with the noise from upstairs any longer.
    我再也受不了樓上的噪音了。
  36. Many young players look up to him.
    很多年輕選手都很尊敬他。
  37. How do you put up with your noisy neighbors?
    你怎麼忍受得了那麼吵的鄰居？
  38. Don't ask too much of your children.
    不要對你的孩子要求太多。
  39. My boss asks too much of me.
    我老闆對我要求太多。
  40. The coach asks a lot of his players.
    教練對他的球員要求很多。
  41. Our teacher asks a lot of us before exams.
    我們老師在考試前對我們要求很多。
